verdict.rationale: Supermemory publishes an official MCP server that gives any MCP-compatible assistant a shared memory layer. The assistant picks the right Supermemory tool from natural-language requests, and spaces scope the context. A separate remote docs MCP is offered for coding agents, and a community report independently confirms wide real-world use of Supermemory MCP. Missing for 10: step-by-step client connection/configuration details and an enumerated tool list in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Supermemory MCP gives every MCP-compatible assistant a shared memory layer
The assistant selects the right Supermemory tool without requiring code or tool names.
Remote MCP that lets the agent search Supermemory documentation while it implements an integration.
